en.headline: Police seize 10 cars in Clear Water Bay anti-illegal racing operation
en.dek: East Kowloon traffic officers intercepted 15 private cars on Mid-Autumn night; 10 were detained for suspected illegal modifications after intelligence indicated a planned race.
body: Police from the East Kowloon Region Traffic Enforcement and Control Division conducted an intelligence-led operation code-named "Torch" in the Clear Water Bay area on Mid-Autumn Festival night, targeting suspected illegal racing.

Officers intercepted 15 private cars believed to be gathering for a race. Preliminary checks found that 10 of the vehicles were suspected of illegal modifications in breach of the Road Traffic (Construction and Maintenance of Vehicles) Regulations.

The 10 cars were towed to the Kowloon Bay Vehicle Examination Centre for further inspection. Police said the operation was mounted before any race could take place and that they would continue to strengthen enforcement at traffic black spots to combat illegal racing and dangerous driving.
The force reiterated that illegal racing endangers other road users and remains a priority for traffic enforcement.

zh.headline: 中秋夜清水灣打擊非法賽車 10車疑非法改裝被扣查
zh.dek: 東九龍總區交通部中秋夜在清水灣一帶展開代號「火炬」行動，截查15輛私家車，其中10輛懷疑非法改裝被扣留。
body: 東九龍總區交通部執行及管制組於中秋夜在清水灣一帶展開代號「火炬」的交通執法行動，打擊非法賽車。
行動以情報主導，懷疑一批經非法改裝的車輛於午夜時段前往清水灣一帶聚集及準備非法賽車。人員及時於該批車輛競賽前截查，共截查15輛可疑私家車。
經初步檢驗，其中10輛懷疑經非法改裝，涉嫌違反《道路交通（車輛構造及保養）規例》，已被扣留於九龍灣車輛檢驗中心作進一步檢驗。
警方表示會繼續以不同行動模式在區內交通黑點加強執法，預防及打擊非法賽車及危險駕駛等違法行為，保障市民安全。
